Lo mantengo: el estiramiento extremo pide prudencia en el tamano, no un cambio de sesgo -- el contra-caso no es lo bastante fuerte todavia para degradar.
counterCase.en: bearish with real force: it's very stretched (9.4 ATR, the most extreme of the five) and the VWAP (101.29) sits well below, a sign of a day that ran without a pause; if Asia fails to hold the pullback at 101.9-102.3 and loses the VWAP, the breakout comes into doubt for the first time since the EIA. I'm keeping it: the extreme stretch calls for caution on size, not a bias change -- the counter-case isn't strong enough yet to downgrade.
